x-unwire-open: Merge: the published spec (/api-docs/swagger-ui-init.js) has one operation, POST /orders under server /b2b/v2: kept as /b2b/v2/orders, the web UI routes use the root.

Auth: login answers a JWT (main.js:1:45329), the interceptor sends it as "Authorization: Bearer" on every request plus "X-User-Email" (main.js:1:453996); the login also sets a "token" cookie (main.js:1:47376). Route guards: token (main.js:1:50059), role admin (main.js:1:50659), role accounting (main.js:1:50954).

Lazy chunks: the webpack runtime builds chunk names at runtime (runtime.js, e => (592===e ? "common" : e) + ".js"); the ids come from c.e(<id>) in main.js and were loaded with -Script (103, 112, 202, 472, 535, common, 613, 67, 745, 859, 98).
Source maps: none, every *.map answered with the SPA page; analysis from the minified bundles.
Skipped scripts: 2 from another origin (cookieconsent, jquery from cdnjs.cloudflare.com).
WebSocket: socket.io on <origin>/socket.io (main.js:1:119956), events like verifyLocalXssChallenge; not an HTTP operation, not in the spec.

Navigation left out: window.open of /ftp/order_<orderId>.pdf (main.js:1:276836, main.js:1:295496), window.location.replace /profile and /dataerasure (server pages, main.js:1:409255), ./redirect?to= links (main.js:1:254604).

Other origins left out: OAuth userinfo at www.googleapis.com (main.js:1:45961), Ethereum RPC and explorer endpoints of a web3 library (202.js:1:14011; 67.js:1:3101; 745.js:1:2726; 98.js:1:189567-206010, InfuraProvider URLs "/v3/" at 98.js:1:202524; 98.js:1:203944), compiler list (202.js:1:425821).
Library code left out: the fetch wrapper of a web3 library (98.js:1:189746-193412; 98.js:1:291923), a file-saver XHR (vendor.js:1:220277, vendor.js:1:220465).
